reason: My family already answers the phone part of the day and I call everyone back in the evening, so I don't see jobs slipping away. I'm not paying 990 euros plus 149 a month to fix a problem I don't have.
objection: I don't lose jobs as it is, and my regular customers know me. A machine texting them for me feels impersonal, and two founders with no customers might not be around in two years.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from my own phone that I'm actually losing calls I never get back to, say a month of missed-call numbers that never rang again, plus a free trial with no setup fee.
